subject: [PATCH 11/11] nfsd: take the write delegation grant stat before hashing

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSv4 delegation grant process to take a stat of the file before hashing the delegation. This is done by moving the nfs4_delegation_stat function above nfs4_set_delegation and passing the current filehandle into nfs4_set_delegation for the stat's export. The patch also adds a second stat after hashing, and declines the delegation if the change attribute has moved. This ensures that the delegation grant is accurate and prevents potential issues with stale values.
